color-no-hex.message: A hex colour `%s` is authored colour. Use a `--vx-*` colour token (`var(--vx-ink)`), or `color-mix` over one.

color-named.message: The named colour `%s` is authored colour. Use a `--vx-*` colour token, or `color-mix` over one.

function-disallowed-list.message: `%s()` writes a colour by hand. Use a `--vx-*` colour token, or `color-mix(in oklab, var(--vx-token) 40%, transparent)` for an alpha; a token already switches per scheme.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Disallowed `%s: %s`. By property: padding, margin, gap and inset (top, right, bottom, left) take a --vx-rhythm-* token (--vx-rhythm-1 to -3), 0, auto or %, and font size a --vx-text-* token, never a raw length or calc(); background, border, outline and shadow take the colour role of their surface, never a status or chart colour; color-mix runs over --vx tokens or transparent only; color takes a text role (Status or Num tone from parts; text-good or text-brand at bridge), never a fill-only role (chart, seq, the brand fill); grid-template-columns and -rows size tracks by fr, auto or minmax(0,1fr), never a raw length; width, min-width and a flex basis above 384px are parent-owned (size the container, not the child); overflow auto|scroll is ui/scroll-area, or let Page own the scroll.

declaration-property-value-allowed-list.message: Disallowed `%s: %s`. Radius, shadow, line height and letter spacing take a `--vx-*` token, `0`, `none` or `inherit`.

property-disallowed-list.message: Never declare `%s`: a `--vx-*` token is derived from the palette config, not authored. Read it with `var()`, or retune `basalt()` options.

declaration-no-important.message: Never force a style with `!important`. Add a variant or prop on the component, or raise the layer.

media-feature-name-disallowed-list.message: The media feature `%s` keys styles on the window or the system scheme. A viewport feature (width, height, aspect ratio, orientation): key on the container, `@container` with a named size (`@narrow`, `@regular`, `@wide`), or `useSizeClass()` for chrome. `prefers-color-scheme`: tokens switch per scheme, so use a `--vx-*` token instead of a dark fork.

selector-disallowed-list.message: Never select `%s`. A `data-slot` or `.mantine-*` selector reaches into a component: use the component's own prop or variant, or eject it (basalt-ui eject <name>). A `data-theme` or `.dark` selector forks a colour per scheme: tokens switch per scheme, so use a `--vx-*` token instead.

at-rule-disallowed-list.message: `%s` adds to or rebuilds what the package owns: a utility class, a theme colour, a variant, the classes of a plugin, a class list the class rules check or a tailwind.config file that declares them. Take colour from Status, Lozenge, DeltaBadge or a Num tone (the palette is derived, never declared per app); tokens switch per scheme, so a `@variant dark` fork is a `--vx-*` token instead (add the token instead of forking); long-form text is `Prose` from basalt-ui/page, never a typography plugin; compose the shipped component and its variants, or a `--vx-*` token in a module stylesheet.
